activities.text: The customer chooses a specific car from the catalog.
The customer asks the salesperson for an offer.
The salesperson offers a contract for a car with a monthly installment to the customer.
The customer signs the contract with the salesperson.
The salesperson passes the contract on to the risk manager.
The risk manager assesses the risk for the contract.
The risk manager votes on the contract.
The risk manager informs the salesperson about the voting result.
The salesperson hands over the car to the customer.
The customer pays the monthly installment regularly.
The customer returns the car to the salesperson after the leasing period.

activities.text: The risk manager fills out the credit rating form with information from the contract on the rating agency website.
The rating agency website generates a credit rating report for the risk manager.
The risk manager creates risk assessment for the contract with credit rating report in the risk management system.
The risk manager decides on a voting result for the risk assessment in the risk management system.
The risk manager passes the voted contract on to the sales person.
The sales person signs the voted contract.

An evaluation of the credit risk of the customer, Expressed by a letter from A (excellent) to D (poor).
based on the car price and the credit rating

activities.text: The risk manager fetches credit rating for the contract from the rating agency.
The risk manager votes the contract with voting result based on the car price and the credit rating.
The risk manager passes the voted contract on to the sales person.
The sales person signs the voted contract.
